proposed.text: What does the Code say about competing based on lower professional charges?

options.text: It is required for all residential projects.
It is allowed if another architect is already commissioned.
The architect must not knowingly compete on that basis.

proposed.rationale: The profession-duty section says the architect shall not knowingly compete with other architects based on differences in professional charges.
